$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/youtube-connector - the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol section 4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. The four gate contexts below are exactly the contexts this repository's main ruleset requires, each carrying the reusable workflow it calls and the 40-character sha this repository's OWN caller pins for it; the truthful-attribution-gate context carries its callerPath and allowedEvents together with the reusable workflow it calls and the 40-character engine sha its caller's uses: line pins (that caller is itself a high-risk path), so the merge road reads the engine pin from this suite. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (config/high-risk-defaults.json, highRiskGlobs; the engine's classifyHighRisk fails closed unless the effective set is a superset); it is the UNION of the central defaults at BOTH engines that read it - the one this repository's attribution caller pinned at the suite's birth (8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, 28 globs; the caller now pins 1e40675e1642dcc32d195f27b3deb285b4d3d6fc, whose defaults are the same 35 globs) and the one the merge road is written against (416a75707fdcfeb768b41c3a54f944078d1ab8fc, 35 globs, which adds the docs-publish-pipeline class) - so the effective set is a superset for either engine; this repository adds nothing of its own beyond that union, because the two additions it would need - ".github/**" and "**/gate-suite.json" - are already central defaults, and the repository carries no release or publish script of its own (its only release path, .github/workflows/release.yml, is covered by ".github/**"). High-risk changes (this file is itself one - see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the section 4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns greater than 35d, fails the gate arm greater than 65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-09-16 birth of this suite on its own pull request, opened under the committed-check-suite program tracked in the organisation private planning repository (issue references deliberately omitted here, as that repository is private and this one is public): the four requiredContexts entries were read from this repository's main ruleset (baseline-protection, ruleset 17470162) and each pin read from this repository's own caller workflow at head 9eb86b24c7fb36a89bb647388e1abd03d06524ef (actions-pinned-gate and gitignore-gate at 4c903fe9ca71ad47752a2bc92b72893e5f7c9814, source-leak-gate at 00ac7b92c2ca1ca291a1824d743cbd00c4a3e48e, secret-scan-gate at a8677e50ba02fcb11929e94c70fb5ba96a8ea3ae), the attribution context was taken by name from its caller (.github/workflows/truthful-attribution-gate.yml, engine pin 8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, WARN mode), its allowedEvents mirroring the caller's own on: triggers exactly (pull_request and push; merge_group is NOT listed, because this caller declares no merge_group trigger and this repository has no merge queue, and the engine treats allowedEvents as a fail-closed allow-list of the Actions run event, so admitting an event the caller cannot fire could only ever let through a run that verified nothing), highRiskPaths is the union of the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults at both engines that read it (28 globs at 8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2 and 35 globs at 416a75707fdcfeb768b41c3a54f944078d1ab8fc, defaults version 2026.06 at both, the seven docs-publish-pipeline globs coming from the latter), and the five listed contexts are the ones the merge road must read concluded-success on the reviewed head.
